cap.ocrHintBody:
RapidOCR is not detected. OCR will fall back to system tesseract.

RapidOCR provides significantly better recognition accuracy. Recommended install:
    pip install rapidocr[onnxruntime]

See assets/plugins/README.md for details.
cap.waylandHintBody:
Running under a Wayland session.

Due to Wayland security isolation, global X11 hotkeys (e.g. Ctrl+Alt+A) cannot intercept keypresses while native Wayland applications are focused.

Recommended alternatives:
1. Configure a custom shortcut in system Settings -> Keyboard Shortcuts running: screencapture --auto-quit=true
2. Or click the system tray icon to trigger screenshot.
